spec_family.name: Interior Closet Shelf Repaint
spec_family.description: Repaint of previously painted fixed closet shelving systems in residential homes. Covers shelf surfaces, cleats, and rods counted by opening tier (S/M/L/XL) per BuiltIns_Shelving Quantification System. Simplest interior RP spec — utility surfaces with lower quality expectations (QT2-QT3 only), brush/roll-only application, and minimal protection. RP additions over NC: condition assessment, degloss, state-driven primer, mildew treatment, customer walkthrough.

includes: Fixed closet shelf surfaces (top, bottom, front edge)
Closet rods (if paintable wood/metal, counted as opening component)
Shelf-to-wall caulk joint repair (failed sections only)
Condition assessment and substrate state assignment
State-driven RP primer (adhesion, stain-block, mildew — conditional)

excludes.route_to: General contractor — must be resolved before painting

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier — drives prep intensity, coat count, and inspection rigor
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT4/QT5 excluded — closet shelving is utility-grade surface where fine-finish prep is not justified. QT2=economy (1 coat, minimal prep, 0.85x modifier). QT3=standard (2 coats, thorough prep, 1.0x baseline).
Spray excluded — small scope, enclosed space, utility surface, occupied home. Brush/roll only.
Flat for maximum hide. Eggshell for slight washability (default). Satin for visible walk-in closets/pantries.

configuration_dimensions.description: Existing paint condition — drives primer selection and conditional task activation
configuration_dimensions.notes: Most common: SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT (simple refresh, no primer). Second most common: SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE (bathroom/basement closets).

paintable_items.name: Closet shelf opening
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count openings by size tier: S (6-18" x 6-18"), M (18-36" x 12-30"), L (36-60" x 18-42"), XL (60"+ x 30"+). Each opening includes visible shelf surfaces, cleats, and rod if present. Per BuiltIns_Shelving Quantification System.
paintable_items.notes: Same item and counting rules as NC spec (SF_CLOSET_SHELF_NC). Opening dimensions do not change for repaint.

variants.notes: Single variant — all closet shelf RP work includes the same item. No variant complexity.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Detail modifier: SIMPLE_BOX / FACE_FRAME / CROWN_VALANCE / BEADED_ROUTED
Floor protection area under closet opening
Surface condition (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) for prep intensity modifier
Interior substrate state — drives primer selection and conditional task activation
Home built before 1978 — triggers RRP lead-safe module

protection_zones_required.notes: Drop cloth under closet opening. Always required — RP always has finished floors. Minimal protection footprint (1 zone only).

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Shelf back meets closet wall. Gap caulked during prep. No cut-in at paint time. Brush/roll on shelves creates no overspray risk. No masking needed.

valid_input_states.notes: Interior closet shelf RP operates on previously painted surfaces. All 5 interior RP states supported. Does NOT accept SS_BARE, SS_PRIMED_*, or NC states — bare/uncoated substrates are NC scope.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by selected sheen. Eggshell is default.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Brush/roll application on shelving creates no overspray risk. No wall masking needed regardless of wall state.

site_condition_rules.effect: Floor protection always required — RP always has finished floors.
Active moisture = STOP condition. Source must be resolved before painting. Recently wet with no active source = proceed with mildew treatment.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: Floor protection may overlap with closet wall RP (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP) but protection footprints are typically different. No deduplication needed.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Closet shelf RP may run in same session as closet wall/ceiling RP. Sequence: walls first, then shelves (to avoid drips on freshly painted walls).

change_log.author: SpecFactory Pipeline
changes: 15 tasks: 7 DIRECT from NC, 5 MODIFIED, 3 RP_NEW
4 material systems: 3 shared RP primers + SYS_CLOSET_SHELF_STANDARD finish
QT2 modifier set to 0.85x (vs global 0.80x) per research RF-001 — closets require basic adhesion prep even at economy tier
